trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

- **Confirmed the issue**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an ~18% error rate.
- **Rolled back to v2.3.0** — the most recent release that was healthy in production — across all production regions. The rollback was verified as rolled out successfully.
- **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback action taken. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure still needs investigation before a fixed version can be released.
